companies.name: ダイコム・インダストリーズ

relations.text: Dycomが10-Kで、売上の10.8%をLumenから得ると記載
relations.text_en: Dycom derived 10.8% of contract revenues from Lumen

source.label: Dycom Industries 10-K(2026年1月期)
source.quote: During fiscal 2026, we derived approximately 25.4% of our total contract revenues from AT&T Inc., 14.0% from Verizon Communications, Inc. and 10.8% from Lumen Technologies Inc.

companies.name: ヴィアヴィ・ソリューションズ

relations.text: Viaviが10-Kで、顧客の一社に挙げる
relations.text_en: Viavi names Lumen among its customers

source.label: Viavi Solutions 10-K(2025年6月期)
source.quote: Examples of our customers include América Móvil, AT&T Inc., Lumen Technologies, Inc. (formerly CenturyLink, Inc.), Ciena, Cisco Systems, Inc., Ericsson, Nokia

relations.text: 11州の家庭向け光回線事業をAT&Tに57.5億ドルで売却(2026年2月完了)
relations.text_en: Sold its fiber-to-the-home business in 11 states to AT&T for $5.75 billion (closed Feb 2026)

source.label: Lumen Technologies 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: On February 2, 2026, we completed our sale of our Mass Markets Fiber-to-the-Home business in the Territory ("Mass Markets Fiber-to-the-Home business") to AT&T in exchange for gross cash proceeds of $5.75 billion

relations.text: LumenのCDN顧客契約の一部を取得(2023年10月)
relations.text_en: Acquired certain customer contracts from Lumen (Oct 2023)

source.label: Akamai 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: We acquired certain customer contracts from Lumen Technologies, Inc. ("Lumen") in October 2023

companies.name: コルト・テクノロジー・サービシズ

relations.text: 欧州・中東・アフリカ事業を17億ドルで売却(2023年)
relations.text_en: Sold its EMEA business for $1.7 billion (2023)

source.label: Lumen Technologies 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: sold Lumen's operations in Europe, the Middle East and Africa ("EMEA") to Colt Technology Services Group Limited, a portfolio company of Fidelity Investments, for pre-tax cash proceeds of $ 1.7 billion

companies.name: オプティマム・コミュニケーションズ

relations.text: Optimumが10-Kで、法人通信の主な競合に挙げる
relations.text_en: Optimum names Lumen a main competitor in business telecom

source.label: Optimum Communications 10-K/A(2025年度)
source.quote: compete primarily with local incumbent telephone companies, especially AT&T, Lumen Technologies, Inc.

relations.text: Tucowsが10-Kで、Ting光回線の競合に挙げる
relations.text_en: Tucows names Lumen among broadband providers competing with Ting

source.quote: Broadband providers such as AT&T, Comcast, Verizon and Lumen Technologies, who primarily compete with Ting Internet services.
